VERDICT:
REASONING:

RISKS:

Context — Kalshi weather markets (daily HIGH/LOW ~19 cities + hourly NYCH). Fair-value engine is separate (NWP ensemble + EMOS + learning cells). market_layers is the microstructure stack, ENABLED, shadow influence only until models arm.

LIVE COUNTS (2026-07-25):
- ml_book_snapshots: 36.2M (live, age ~0s)
- ml_trades: 704k
- ml_flow_signals: 144k (labeled 142.6k, pending 1.4k, acted_would_have_traded 94k)
- ml_signal_outcomes: 273k
- ladder_links: 2782
- candles_book + ou_features_book: 7 days each
- hourly_coverage fresh window: 0 tickers right now

WHAT IT DOES TODAY:
1) Recorder: WS book deltas + trades into SQLite (daily+hourly ladders)
2) Features: spread, micro_dev, depth imbalance; signed_vol/aggression/intensity at 30s/2m/10m; mid_drift same windows; cross-ladder lag_gap; dist_to_50, hour_utc, mins_to_settle
3) Labels: 1m and 5m horizons; label=1 iff mid drifts BEYOND signal-time spread+fee in one direction
4) Train: HistGB + isotonic; up/down models separate; promote if beats naive+incumbent AND usable_base_rate in [0.02,0.98]
5) Gate: fair value decides WHETHER; flow shrink-only {0,0.5,1.0} size mult when armed
6) Nightly label+prune+train; bridge.flow_size_mult on live path (noop until armed)

TRAIN REPORT PROBLEM:
- 5m/down and 5m/up: n_train~82k, beats_naive=true, but base_rate_val ~1.4–1.8% → usable_base_rate=false → state LEARNING forever
- 1m: base_rate ~0.3% even worse
- avg_drift ~0 to -0.04c — markets almost never move beyond round-trip cost on these horizons

Fair-value side still has 0 ARMED cells; daily NO miscalibrated; hourly calibrated but negative edge after fees.

Questions:
1) Given this data richness but near-zero label base rates, how should we UTILIZE the flow data? (redefine labels, continuous targets, CLV vs settlement, fill quality, execution timing only, join to weather edge, etc.)
2) Best ordered plan that keeps shrink-only safety and does not arm junk.
3) Which feature groups / horizons / markets (daily vs hourly) are most promising given thin books?
4) How to use book candles + OU book features with the flow DB without train/serve skew.

Be concrete, ordered, reuse existing tables/code. Short sections.
